central_inscription_policy: Transcribe the central inscription specified by each neutral box kind. Contextual fragments from adjacent inscriptions are excluded; permitted originals were consulted for placement and cropped-edge context.

inspection_notes.observation: Long oblique rules cross the upper group. Local horizontal cancellation and local replacements are encoded explicitly. The crossed initial word below the header is only partly legible. Primes in the cancelled right-hand conclusion cannot be separated confidently from overlying added ink. The right-edge parenthetical addition has no secure visible closing parenthesis.

The rotated marginal note has a long crossing stroke through its right portion, a connector after NB, and a second oblique across the lower lines. They are drawn separately without silently assigning cancellation to the whole note. The first relation after Car is heavily retraced; the cancelled word after c'est and the small introductory La remain doubtful. A plus is visibly raised after the later Z. The bottom intersection/empty-set formula is underlined.

Several C/G forms are physically open and end in a short lower hook; ambiguous occurrences retain C/G alternatives. They are not normalized to one variable. The dense cancelled span before the added L formula has readable fragments but not a secure complete formula.

The underlined title ends before the numeral 2. The Sup operator has an initial capital. The mark after pour is H-shaped and is retained as forall/H rather than silently normalized. The rule beneath the last sentence curves up at the right; a separate oblique crosses the parallel sign, so the diagonal is reproduced separately from that relation.

The title reads Propriete 1, with underline including the number. C/G alternatives remain at open lower-hook forms. The final crossing relation is heavily retraced; no separate negation is inferred solely from its greater ink density.

The reference has a barred and underlined VI. The page token has a 13/B-like conjoined shape, retained as uncertain. The small sign between cf and GF may be a cancelled p. or a section sign. The lower crossed row has an unrecovered opening span; only securely visible fragments are supplied.

The allowed lower-half source was also viewed for placement. The a before l'ancien lies at the left edge/outside the tight B021 crop but is visible in that source. The lower marginal note has an underlined heading and a further rule below sous-figures; the rule crosses tall strokes near Mais and is not silently taken as cancellation of the whole note. Several compressed words remain marked.

The drawing is an open-corner quadrilateral with a diagonal, an oval-like curve, and two dark contact points on the diagonal. It includes a small inner cross, a retraced cross-like mark to the right, a lower plus, and an oblique double-stroke arrow. The slight gaps and open curve end are preserved by separate paths rather than silently closed.

The note says Mais on aura before the subscripted parallel formula. In the following conclusion the relation has two verticals and two near-horizontal cross-strokes; a hash-like source form is preferred, with barred parallel retained as an alternative. The citation includes GF VI and the numerals 11 and 67,68. The expanded form of the contre-ex... word and Cofinite remain doubtful.

Exact-coordinate crop rotated clockwise 45 degrees and directly reinspected. Short inserted word remains physically ambiguous: initial au-like cluster, small inner loops, dot, and long terminal stroke; aussi/au lieu retained.

Central conclusion read in exact crop and permitted original lower image. Indexed relation is densely retraced, preserved as an uncertain source-shaped crossing-chevron glyph. The small est-like group in parentheses may carry a local strike; uncertainty in state retained. Distinct long left rule is represented independently in B028.
Single near-vertical rule, descending slightly to the right; small clipped ink at left is contextual rather than part of central rule.

Corollaire is underlined; numeral 1 stands to its right. The noun propriété has raised paired quotation strokes. Article is cramped at its baseline and retained la/le. No visible connecting hyphen between ci and dessus.

The varying open bowl capitals have short lower-right hooks but no secure internal bar in this crop; C/G alternatives are retained at those occurrences. The primed C before the second double less-than has an open lower bowl and no internal bar. Corollaire alone is underlined; numeral 2 stands clear of underline.

Plus gén. is abbreviated and has a clear terminal point. Both lower indexed letters have open C-shaped bowls with short lower-right hooks; C/G alternatives retained. Both lower L indices, both primes and the double implication are clear.

validation_scope: Only box count/order, nonempty two-column format, and crop manifest coordinates checked against the neutral box list. No textual comparison.
